review_candidates.description: SEB is a leading northern European financial services group, with a history dating back to 1856. Innovation, entrepreneurship and an international perspective are part of our identity. SEB started its operations in Luxembourg in 1973, and we continue to grow with our customers and community over 50 years later. The Asset Management division of SEB offers a wide range of products and advisory services aimed at private individuals, institutional investors and distributors. We provide broad solutions as well as niche products across asset classes such as equities, fixed income and alternatives. Additionally, we manage funds and discretionary mandates on behalf of institutional investors. SEB in Luxembourg has approximately 150 employees representing more than 20 different nationalities, creating a truly diverse and multicultural workplace. About The Position SEB Asset Management is establishing a new international sales hub in Luxembourg as part of its long-term European growth strategy. We are now looking for a Client Associate to join us in this build-out phase. In this pivotal role you will help shape our international sales presence across the DACH, France and Benelux region, with plans to grow the team further over time. This is a unique opportunity to become a vital part of a group working with a diverse range of institutional and wholesale/distribution clients beyond SEB’s home markets. We are in search of a Client Associate, preferably with an established distribution network and experience from the asset management business to take on this high impact, client-facing position. As part of SEB Asset Management’s international sales team in Luxembourg, you will be assisting our Client Executives in developing and expanding relationships with key fund distributors. You will represent SEB Asset Management’s broad investment capabilities across liquid and alternative strategies, working closely with internal stakeholders to deliver tailored client solutions. You will join a small, senior team focused on international expansion, where individual contribution, ownership, and collaboration are essential. In this role your key responsibilities can be summarized as follows: Assist in growing SEB Asset Management's presence in the DACH, France and Benelux region by supporting sales, client relationships, and business development activities. Work closely with senior client executives to strengthen relationships with distributors and institutional investors. Gain a solid understanding of client portfolios, investment objectives, and market developments to help identify opportunities and support client needs. Support client onboarding, contract negotiations, and commercial discussions. Provide valuable support in crafting responses to RFPs and DDQ’s, showcasing SEB Asset Management’s strengths and capabilities. Act as a trusted partner to clients through regular dialogue, reporting, and market updates, including developments in sustainable investing. The role is based in Luxembourg, however given the international nature of the client base, regular travel will be required. What We Expect To be successful in this role, we expect you to have: Familiarity with the wholesale and institutional investor landscape in the DACH, France and/or Benelux region would be a strong asset. At least 3 years of experience within asset management and fund distribution. Solid understanding of liquid and/or alternative investment strategies. Strong presentation and communication skills; proficiency in English, German and/or French is expected, with additional European language skills considered a plus. A commercial mindset, accountable, strong self‑motivation, and the ability to work independently within a lean, experienced team environment. As a person, you are an enthusiastic, driven team player, combined with the ability to manage key tasks individually. In addition, you demonstrate the following qualities: A client-centric mindset combined with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented approach to tasks Collaborative team player who works effectively across sales, investment, product, and operational teams. Ability to operate confidently in an international, growth-focused environment. What We Offer SEB Asset Management offers a high-quality international platform with strong Nordic investment heritage and a clear growth ambition in Europe. The role provides significant autonomy, direct client responsibility, and exposure to senior decision-makers across the organization. It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity are crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe in and where they come from. Learn more about SEB Asset Management on Asset Management | SEB and working at SEB on Working at SEB | SEB. Ready to join? Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application with a CV and Cover Letter in English as soon as possible, but no later than 16 September 2026. If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Bjarne Steden-Hirschorn, Head of International Asset Management Sales, at Bjarne.steden-hirschorn@seb.dk or +45 24984874. Please note that the successful candidate will be required to provide a Criminal Record Certificate, and a sanctions list screening will be conducted as part of our background check process.

review_candidates.description: About The Company Global University Systems (GUS) is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement. Position The Business Development Manager for International Student Recruitment will oversee all student recruitment activities, business development activities, account management, and marketing events for B2B channels across the country or region you will manage. You will collaborate with Company Directors to develop B2B channels and implement marketing and sales strategies to promote international student recruitment for GUS. You will be representing one of our universities or colleges located in either Europe, North America, or Asia. Requirements Proven experience in student recruitment for French higher education institutions is essential Must have professional fluency in French speaking Minimum of a bachelor's degree, or equivalent, is required Considerable experience working in the education sector; specifically in Colleges and Universities Should have experience in preparing strategies to acquire business in new regions and to develop business in existing regions Experience working with B2B Education Agent partnerships. Previous experience in International Student Recruitment Other Information Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement. We acknowledge receipt of your resume for a position at Global University Systems and sincerely appreciate your interest in our company. We will screen all applicant CVs and select the candidates whose qualifications and experience meet our requirements. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success. GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.
